 PennDOT Driver’s License Centers to Close for Veterans Day
 Pennsylvania Department of Transportation driver’s license and photo centers will be closed Wednesday, Nov. 11, in observance of Veterans Day.
 The closure includes all driver’s license and photo centers statewide, including PennDOT’s full-service center in Harrisburg.
 Many driver and vehicle services will remain available online through PennDOT’s Driver and Vehicle Services website, which operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Services include driver’s license and vehicle registration renewals, address changes, duplicate licenses and photo IDs, driver-history records, REAL ID pre-verification and driver exam scheduling.
 Customers can also pay driver’s license and vehicle insurance restoration fees online. PennDOT says there are no additional fees for using its online services.
 Residents planning to visit a PennDOT Online Messenger Service Center should call ahead to confirm holiday hours. A complete list of driver’s license and photo center closures for 2026 is available on PennDOT’s website.
 PennDOT also reminds travelers that a REAL ID-compliant driver’s license or identification card, or another acceptable form of identification such as a passport, is required to board domestic flights. Information about REAL ID requirements and eligibility is available at pa.gov/REALID .
 Motorists can check traffic conditions, road delays, weather forecasts and traffic cameras through 511PA.com , which is available around the clock online, through a smartphone app or by calling 5-1-1.
